description: Avoid single-character variable names — they hurt readability
Cache repeated database lookups inside the request loop
Never interpolate raw user input directly into SQL queries
Always validate and sanitize file upload extensions before saving to disk
Avoid nested loops over large datasets; prefer hashmaps for lookups
Use consistent indentation and naming conventions across a codebase
Keep business logic out of controller/route handlers
Never log sensitive data such as passwords or access tokens
Batch network or database calls instead of calling them one by one
Favor dependency injection over hard-coded singletons for testability
